title: Signed trusted ingress across the canonical Production host family

phases.objective: Make the shared trusted-ingress contract verify signed attestations against an exact canonical-host allowlist and make the existing auth-mad4b-proxy mint a fresh host-bound Ed25519 attestation for each governed Production public host, while preserving legacy single-host compatibility and failing closed on invalid host or signing configuration.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed edge proxy and shared MCP/OAuth origin runtime
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A request reaches auth.mad4b.com, mcp.mad4b.com, or activation.mad4b.com through the existing auth-mad4b-proxy trusted-ingress path.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Caller-supplied forwarding and attestation headers are stripped, a fresh Ed25519 attestation is bound to the exact public request host and deployment SHA, and the shared origin accepts only a configured canonical host while retaining the legacy single-host contract.
steps: Resolve the public request host only from the governed Production host allowlist.
Strip caller-supplied forwarding, original-host and trusted-ingress attestation headers at the edge boundary.
Mint a short-lived Ed25519 attestation bound to issuer, audience, request ID, unique JTI, exact deployment SHA and exact public request host.
Forward the canonical host separately from the private origin Host header.
Verify the signed attestation at the shared origin against the plural canonical-host allowlist, rejecting duplicates, wildcards, unknown hosts and host mismatches.
Fall back only to the existing legacy single-host configuration when the plural configuration is absent.
Require live Staging certification before promotion or any Production rollout decision.
assertions: Each accepted signed attestation is bound to exactly one canonical request host and cannot be replayed as another allowed host.
The canonical-host allowlist is finite, duplicate-free, wildcard-free and fail-closed.
Incomplete or invalid edge signing configuration fails closed without forwarding an unsigned privileged request.
The legacy REMOTE_MCP_TRUSTED_INGRESS_CANONICAL_HOST path remains backward compatible when the plural host list is absent.
No Production database mutation, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS or route mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read or secret value is authorized or stored by this change.
Live Worker secret provisioning, route binding and Production deployment remain separate governed operations.

phases.objective: Live Production signing-key provisioning, Worker deployment, route binding and external acceptance remain outside this code-change PR.
blockers: Production rollout requires its separate governed provider/deployment authorization and exact-SHA evidence.
This declaration grants no Production database, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare DNS, route, ruleset or secret mutation authority.
